24/S0.subgoal: Explain the definition and key challenges of interactive systems.

24/S1.subgoal: Explain the necessity of knowing users through broad categorization.

24/S2.subgoal: Describe the three broad classifications of users and how they impact design decisions.

24/S3.subgoal: Outline how designers must integrate user characteristics into the software development lifecycle.

24/S4.subgoal: Define usability, list its three crucial aspects, and explain why they matter in product design.

24/S5.subgoal: Identify and define the three primary measures (effectiveness, efficiency, and satisfaction) used to judge system usability.

24/S6.subgoal: Describe user-centered design (UCD), its history, and related terminology.

24/S7.subgoal: Relate user-centered design principles back to the design concerns of interactive systems.

24/S8.subgoal: Describe the data flow and the specific human factors required when designing Extended Reality (XR) systems.

24/S9.subgoal: Summarize the lecture concepts and outline future topics related to human factors in XR.
